logic.text: Ea and ln A spread, and relative k spread at line 125, are calculated as standard deviations.
logic.note: The plan defines each reported spread as a mean absolute error conditional on a valid fit.
logic.fix: Compute the mean absolute value of each trial's error and bootstrap that same statistic for its uncertainty.
logic.name: ea_spread, lnA_spread, k_relative_spread_by_temperature

logic.text: Grid validation derives allowed settings from the supplied records when sweep metadata is absent.
logic.note: A subset of the planned settings can therefore pass validation and produce an incomplete study.
logic.fix: Validate the supplied cells against the explicit planned noise-ratio and time-point grids.
logic.name: noise_ratio, num_time_points

logic.text: The random generator uses the supplied seed directly, while trial_id is unused.
logic.note: The shown code does not construct the per-setting, per-trial SeedSequence specified by the plan.
logic.fix: Construct the generator seed from the base seed and the noise, time-point and trial indices.

logic.text: The reported concentration checks compare locally calculated expressions with themselves, and the nonunit check examines only the initial time.
logic.note: These checks do not test the model function on the stated special-case inputs.
logic.fix: Call the model function with each check's case inputs and compare its output with an independently calculated reference.
logic.name: checks

logic.text: The reported noise-free recovery check uses a different sampling count and fitting path from its stated case.
logic.note: Its result does not check the planned case or the rate-fitting procedure used in trials.
logic.fix: Run the stated noise-free case through the trial fitting path and report its numerical error.
logic.name: noise_free_Ea_fit_J_per_mol

checked: E1 and E2: the marked model functions use the planned exponential forms, factors and signs.
Temperature construction and sampling: inverse-temperature spacing, the Arrhenius rate range, and time endpoints follow the plan.
Concentration simulation: noise uses the stated scale and independent draws within a trial.
Rate fitting: positive k, fixed initial concentration, analytic derivative and known-noise information are used.
Arrhenius fitting: inverse-variance weights, weighted centering, unscaled covariance and the Ea and ln A transforms are used.
Coverage and failure summaries: interval hits are divided by attempted trials, so failed trials count as misses.
Bias and weighting-variance summaries: valid-fit errors and the fitted log-rate variances are averaged.
Figures: all planned files are saved with the specified plotted quantities, references and uncertainty displays.
Special-case trial interface: the stated cases can return c_val, k_val, ln_k_val and Ea_fit.
